options.name: ca_path
options.description: The Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) file that contains a CA certificate to be used for the validation.

options.name: capacity
options.description: Virtual disk size in GB.

options.name: controller_id
options.description: Fully Qualified Device Descriptor (FQDD) of the storage controller, for example 'RAID.Integrated.1-1'. Controller FQDD is required for C(create) RAID configuration.

options.name: disk_cache_policy
options.description: Disk Cache Policy.

options.name: idrac_ip
options.description: iDRAC IP Address.

options.name: idrac_password
options.description: iDRAC user password. If the password is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_PASSWORD) is used. Example: export IDRAC_PASSWORD=password

options.name: idrac_port
options.description: iDRAC port.

options.name: idrac_user
options.description: iDRAC username. If the username is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_USERNAME) is used. Example: export IDRAC_USERNAME=username

options.name: job_wait
options.description: This parameter provides the option to wait for the job completion. This is applicable when I(state) is C(create) or C(delete).

options.name: job_wait_timeout
options.description: This parameter is the maximum wait time of I(job_wait) in seconds. This option is applicable when I(job_wait) is C(true).

options.name: media_type
options.description: Media type.

options.name: number_dedicated_hot_spare
options.description: Number of Dedicated Hot Spare.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Bus protocol.

options.name: raid_init_operation
options.description: This option represents initialization configuration operation to be performed on the virtual disk.

options.name: raid_reset_config
options.description: This option represents whether a reset config operation needs to be performed on the RAID controller. Reset Config operation deletes all the virtual disks present on the RAID controller.

options.name: read_cache_policy
options.description: Read cache policy.

options.name: span_depth
options.description: Number of spans in the RAID configuration. I(span_depth) is required for C(create) and its value depends on I(volume_type).

options.name: span_length
options.description: Number of disks in a span. I(span_length) is required for C(create) and its value depends on I(volume_type).

options.name: state
options.description: C(create), performs create volume operation. C(delete), performs remove volume operation. C(view), returns storage view.

options.name: stripe_size
options.description: Stripe size value to be provided in multiples of 64 * 1024.

options.name: time_to_wait
options.description: The maximum wait time before shutdown in seconds for the Server Configuration Profile (SCP) import operation. This option is applicable when I(state) is C(create) or C(delete).

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), the SSL certificates will not be validated. Configure C(false) only on personally controlled sites where self-signed certificates are used. Prior to collection version C(5.0.0), the I(validate_certs) is C(false) by default.

options.name: volume_id
options.description: Fully Qualified Device Descriptor (FQDD) of the virtual disk, for example 'Disk.virtual.0:RAID.Slot.1-1'. This option is used to get the virtual disk information.

options.name: volume_type
options.description: Provide the the required RAID level.

options.name: volumes
options.description: A list of virtual disk specific iDRAC attributes. This is applicable for C(create) and C(delete) operations. For C(create) operation, name and drives are applicable options, other volume options can also be specified. The drives is a required option for C(create) operation and accepts either location (list of drive slot) or id (list of drive fqdd). In iDRAC8, there is no pre-validation for the state of drives. The disk ID or slot number of the drive provided may or may not be in Ready state. Ent

options.name: write_cache_policy
options.description: Write cache policy.

options.name: x_auth_token
options.description: Authentication token. If the x_auth_token is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_X_AUTH_TOKEN) is used. Example: export IDRAC_X_AUTH_TOKEN=x_auth_token
